modalities.evidence: Electrocardiogram and continuous non-invasive blood pressure signals were recorded

output.population: Healthy volunteers recorded at rest; the database contains recordings of 1,104 healthy volunteers, with signals recorded in 1,121 healthy volunteers.
output.summary: Simultaneous resting electrocardiogram and continuous non-invasive blood pressure recordings from healthy volunteers, collected to describe how cardiovascular autonomic regulation changes with healthy aging.
